header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: No one is present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2024 and thereafter, no efforts were made by counsel for the petitioner to get matter fix and to proceed with it. It appears that the counsel for the petitioner has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
